gradeK.band: Critical Thinking Online Breakouts · a shadow-play STEM challenge · a picture word bank
gradeK.card.p: Turn on a light and learn that we need light to see — and that blocking light makes a shadow. Six picture clues and four locks. ~6–10 minutes.
gradeK.note: 🧑‍🏫 Teacher note: the 10 picture breakouts each cover one big idea (sorting, magnets, day & night, the sky, rocks, weather, air & wind, plant needs, animal needs, and plant parts). Best on the board with the whole class. See Skills & TEKS for the standards. The answer key is password-protected.

grade1.band: Critical Thinking Online Breakouts · a STEM ramp challenge · a picture word bank
grade1.card.p: Help the class at the playground and learn how a push or a pull makes things move. Six picture clues and four locks. ~8–12 minutes.
grade1.note: 🧑‍🏫 Teacher note: the 10 picture breakouts each cover one big idea (sorting, hot & cold, seasons, soil, water, weather, saving water, living things, food chains, and animals). Great on the board with the whole class. See Skills & TEKS for the standards. The answer key is password-protected.

grade2.band: Critical Thinking Online Breakouts · a STEM string-phone challenge · a picture word bank
grade2.card.p: Put on a show and learn how sound is made by things that vibrate — and how it travels to your ears. Six clues and four locks. ~8–12 minutes.
grade2.note: 🧑‍🏫 Teacher note: the 10 concept breakouts each cover one big idea (solids & liquids, changing matter, pushes, Sun & Moon, wind & water, wild weather, recycling, producers & consumers, pollen & seeds, and metamorphosis). See Skills & TEKS for the standards. The answer key is password-protected.

grade3.band: Critical Thinking Online Breakouts · a STEM space-model challenge · a picture word bank
grade3.featname: Blast Off! A Trip Through Space
grade3.card.p: Pilot a spaceship and learn how the planets orbit the Sun and the Moon orbits the Earth. Six clues and four locks. ~10–15 minutes.
grade3.note: 🧑‍🏫 Teacher note: the 10 concept breakouts each cover one key idea (states of matter, changes of state, measuring matter, forces at a distance, forms of energy, how soil forms, rapid Earth changes, food chains, fossils, and survival structures). See Skills & TEKS for the standards. The answer key is password-protected.

grade4.band: Critical Thinking Online Breakouts · a build-a-circuit STEM challenge · a picture word bank
grade4.featname: Light It Up! The Secret of Circuits
grade4.card.p: Fix the classroom lamp and learn how electricity flows in a closed circuit to make light and heat. Six clues and four locks. ~10–15 minutes.
grade4.note: 🧑‍🏫 Teacher note: the 10 concept breakouts each cover one key idea (mixtures & solutions, energy transfer, conductors & insulators, Moon phases, the water cycle, erosion, weather vs. climate, resources, food webs, and inherited vs. acquired traits). See Skills & TEKS for the standards. The answer key is password-protected.

grade5.band: Critical Thinking Online Breakouts · a shadow-tracker STEM challenge · a picture word bank
grade5.featname: Round and Round: Day, Night, and Shadows
grade5.card.p: Solve why the Sun seems to cross the sky and why shadows move — it's all Earth's spin. Six clues and four locks. ~10–15 minutes.
grade5.note: 🧑‍🏫 Teacher note: the 10 concept breakouts each cover one key idea (separating mixtures, particles, forces, energy transformations, light, sedimentary rock & fossil fuels, landforms, ecosystem changes, human impact, and instinct vs. learned behavior). See Skills & TEKS for the standards. The answer key is password-protected.

grade6.band: Critical Thinking Online Breakouts · a STEM engineering challenge · a student word bank
grade6.card.p: Clear the freighter TEKS Voyager to sail — using density, net force, Newton's Third Law, and energy conservation to solve four locks. ~12–18 minutes.
grade6.note: 🧑‍🏫 Teacher note: the 10 concept breakouts introduce or review one key idea each (matter, density, chemical change, forces, energy, waves, seasons & tides, Earth's systems, ecosystems & cells). See Skills & TEKS for the standards alignment and the misconceptions each activity confronts.

grade7.band: Critical Thinking Online Breakouts · a STEM engineering challenge · a student word bank
grade7.card.p: Launch a search-and-rescue mission — reading a drone's distance–time graph, telling speed from velocity, and reasoning about heat and thermal equilibrium to solve four locks. ~12–18 minutes.
grade7.note: 🧑‍🏫 Teacher note: the 10 concept breakouts introduce or review one key idea each (elements & compounds, solutions, motion & graphs, heat transfer, the solar system, plate tectonics, watersheds, energy pyramids, body systems, and classifying life). See Skills & TEKS for the standards alignment and the misconceptions the featured breakout confronts.

grade8.band: Critical Thinking Online Breakouts · a STEM engineering challenge · a student word bank
grade8.card.p: Clear a rocket for launch — proving conservation of mass, predicting acceleration with a = F ÷ m, and naming the telemetry wavelength to solve four locks. ~12–18 minutes.
grade8.note: 🧑‍🏫 Teacher note: the 10 concept breakouts introduce or review one key idea each (classifying matter, acids & bases, conservation of mass, Newton's laws, waves, stars & galaxies, weather systems, carbon & climate, ecosystem change, and cells & heredity). See Skills & TEKS for the standards alignment and the misconceptions the featured breakout confronts.
